Definition: Baal of Shalishah, Baal-Shalishah, a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Baal-shalisha was the place the man came from who brought Elisha twenty loaves of barley and full ears of corn — and Elisha fed a hundred men with it, and there was some left. A small town, one verse, and a miracle of provision.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God feeds a hundred from twenty loaves because he wants his servant to know that the gift is his, not mine — and Baal-shalisha's bread is the proof.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
